dimensions.assessment: Affects telecommunications companies, academic institutions, public interest groups, and government representatives appointed to the task force.
dimensions.evidence: Representatives of companies in the communications industry... public interest organizations or academic institutions... Federal Government, State governments, local governments, or Tribal Governments

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an advisory task force and reporting requirements without enacting new regulatory mandates or funding programs.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Federal Communications Commission to establish a task force to be known as the '6G Task Force'

dimensions.assessment: The source does not mention any appropriations or fiscal costs associated with the task force.
Directs the FCC to form an advisory task force, solicit public comments, and submit reports to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: publish in the Federal Register and on the website of the Commission, and submit to the Committee on Energy and Commerce... a report on sixth-generation wireless technology

dimensions.assessment: Temporary task force operation concluding with a final report submitted approximately one year after establishment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date on which the Task Force is established... the Task Force shall publish... a report

missing_information: Funding sources or budgetary allocations for the operation of the task force.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the FCC to establish a 6G Task Force composed of industry, academic, and government representatives to publish a draft report, gather public comments, and submit a final report on sixth-generation wireless technology standards and uses within one year.
